known_text: I didn't want to ask you how to say it.

use.known: I didn't want to bother you with this question.
use.target: 我不想用这个问题打扰你。

use.known: I forgot how to say that word in Chinese.
use.target: 我忘了那个词中文怎么说。

use.known: I wanted to ask her but she was too busy.
use.target: 我想问她但是她太忙了。

use.known: If I don't know something, I will ask you.
use.target: 如果我不知道，我会问你。

use.known: They told me how to do it but I forgot again.
use.target: 他们告诉了我怎么做但是我又忘了。

use.known: Everyone thinks I know the answer but I don't.
use.target: 大家都想我知道回答但是我不知道。
